name: Proposed Annual School Calendar
description: Preparation of the annual school calendar for Board consideration so the Board can adopt it in a timely way.
deadline: no later than October 31, unless another date is agreed to in advance
quote: In order to facilitate the Board’s timely adoption of the school calendar, the Superintendent or designee shall be responsible for preparing an annual school calendar for Board consideration no later than October 31, unless another date is agreed to in advance.
